articles.title: Latest investigation of Bitcoin founder ties identity to Blockstream CEO Adam Back
articles.summary: The New York Times claims to have identified Satoshi Nakamoto, the pseudonymous creator of Bitcoin. The report names Adam Back, 55-year-old CEO of Blockstream, as the individual. This potential unmasking of Bitcoin's founder is a significant development in the world of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology, impacting discussions on digital finance and future economic systems and highlighting the evolving landscape of global technology.

articles.title: Army chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi visits HAL, takes sortie in LCH Prachand
articles.summary: Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi recently visited Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) in Bengaluru, undertaking his maiden sortie in the indigenous Light Combat Helicopter (LCH) Prachand. This significant engagement underscores the Indian Army's focus on integrating advanced, domestically manufactured defence platforms, bolstering self-reliance, and enhancing combat capabilities for future operations.

articles.title: AI-Infused Development Needs More Than Prompts
articles.summary: Current discussions on AI in software development are critiqued for focusing too narrowly on code generation. The article suggests this represents a 'wrong layer' of engagement, implying AI's true potential lies in deeper, more strategic contributions to software engineering. For SSB aspirants, understanding this evolving technological landscape highlights the need to grasp AI's broader implications for innovation and national capabilities.

articles.title: Dubai Gold District Brings the Gold Souk Experience to Your Doorstep
articles.summary: The Dubai Gold District has launched a new concierge home delivery service for gold and jewellery, directly responding to the rising demand across the UAE. This initiative offers customers increased convenience, reflecting evolving consumer preferences and the robust growth of the gold market in the region. It highlights innovation in service delivery for luxury goods.
